candidates.title: Contextual pair synergy before feature expansion
candidates.mechanism: Positive contextual interaction information retains weak marginal parents, then expands typed pairs. Conditional proxy is not utility conditional on all B.
observables: mature early-development labels for future selector only
candidates.novelty_delta: Pair lookahead and marginal-parent survival versus generic grammar HYP002/059 and residual probe HYP013; old root family acknowledged.
duplicate_rejections: MI named as generic feature selection
new count cross without selector contrast
candidates.counterhypothesis: Sparse labels destabilize information estimates; CatBoost already learns interactions.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Planned eight-row balanced XOR/redundant-parent literal fixture; zero marginal XOR information, one-bit joint information, nonpositive duplicate synergy.
candidates.matched_strong_control: Frozen B primary; B+3 synergy-first versus B+3 marginal-first, same parent pool/materialization/search counts.

candidates.title: Directed family migration for typed feature compositions
candidates.mechanism: Three family archives, stagnation-triggered cross-family subtree composition, directed donor-recipient weights updated by a frozen fit-free contextual-information proxy.
observables: symbolic typed AST and parent family
mature earlier selector labels in future phase
candidates.novelty_delta: Stateful connectivity and cross-family child reachability differ from static016 and static/blinded/seeded proposer HYP012. No LLM reproduction claim.
duplicate_rejections: fresh LLM name over existing proposer mechanism
candidates.counterhypothesis: Noisy adaptive weights add no benefit over uniform migration and matched search opportunities.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Planned <=64-AST literal grammar demonstrates target unreachable within families but reachable by one legal composition; replay deterministic synthetic proxy against uniform route.
candidates.matched_strong_control: Frozen B primary; B+3 learned-route versus B+3 uniform-route, common24-program pool and equal eight proxy feedback evaluations each.

sources.owned_claim: TopoFE combines family-specialized islands, prompt memory, learned directed transfer weights and saturation-triggered LLM hybrid synthesis; local typed mutator is our distinct adaptation.

candidates.title: Shared symbolic feature search then local adaptation across related tasks
candidates.mechanism: One shared AST interface scores a program across three predeclared past-defined tasks; task-normalized contextual information selects initialization before one local mutation per task. Final pooled learner serves all task slices.
observables: past-defined category or history-support task membership
mature earlier selector outcomes for future search
schema_units: same query can contribute to dependent diagnostic slices; no independence claim
candidates.novelty_delta: Multi-objective reusable symbolic structure before adaptation differs from lexical/embedding transfer HYP003/051 and post-hoc category slicing.
duplicate_rejections: manually copying one feature across categories
one global search followed by category slice reporting
claiming adapter compatibility is learned transfer
candidates.counterhypothesis: Tasks are insufficiently related; shared selection causes negative transfer or is dominated by sparse task support.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Planned three literal tasks: two share a formula, third has opposite sign; verify shared objective/local mutation and expose incompatible task failure.
candidates.matched_strong_control: Frozen B primary; shared-init B+3 versus independently initialized B+3 with identical nine task-program scores per policy and same initial two programs.

sources.owned_claim: EMO-STA has shared archive evolution followed by task-specific initialization/adaptation under a shared executable interface; our typed fit-free selector is not their LLM method.

candidates.title: Learn typed grammar macros by compressing program archives
candidates.mechanism: Induce parameterized typed subtree abstractions from a frozen archive, then expand macro calls into audited primitive ASTs for search/materialization.
observables: future successful program archives only with provenance
schema_units: physical columns and materialization cost remain cost units
candidates.novelty_delta: Learned abstractions alter proposal probabilities across future tasks; hand-specified016templates and shared physical DAGs do not induce libraries.
duplicate_rejections: token-depth budget advantage from concealed expansion
candidates.counterhypothesis: Compression renames the same programs without improving held-family discovery; current eight bundles are too small.
candidates.cheapest_falsification: Planned <=20 literal ASTs, <=4 induced macros, one held-out compositional family; compare discovery at equal expanded-node opportunities with unchanged grammar.
candidates.matched_strong_control: Symbolic primitive grammar first; only later frozen B plus B+3 macro-search versus B+3 primitive-search, charging archive creation.
